Note to the permits officer, 22 October 2027.

Application NE-27-044 from Brennick Civil Ltd asks for a noise exemption to resurface Station Road overnight, 23:00 to 05:00, on 4 nights, 8 to 11 November 2027. City noise rule: construction noise is not allowed from 22:00 to 07:00 in residential areas without an exemption. An exemption may be granted only when (a) daytime work would cause serious traffic disruption or a safety risk, and (b) every address within 100 m receives written notice at least 7 full days before work starts (not counting the day the notice is delivered or the first day of work). The officer may attach conditions to an exemption.

Station Road carries about 22,000 vehicles a day and is the main route to the hospital; the transport department supports night work. Brennick plans to deliver letters to 140 addresses on 2 November. Noise forecast at the nearest homes: 78 dB on nights 1 and 2 (milling), 65 dB on nights 3 and 4 (paving).
